The '''Edan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and contained the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. It played a minor role in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
